name: Material Graph tab in the world editor with live preview
body: A Material Graph tab opened from a material Silhouette (Edit graph), reusing the graph canvas with a material palette and the output node's pins. Saving writes the graph, regenerates and recompiles the shader, and the preview viewport (a sphere and a cube) and the level reload the material's pipeline, so edits show live.

comments.text: Done on PR #220 (slice 4): Materials list in the Graph tab, material:<name> graphs, starter graph, live preview cube, viewport draws graph materials. D-262.
